data.title: The strip beside the balcony door
data.goal: The strip beside the balcony door

data.situation:
On a January morning, Lin pulled the curtain aside and found ice along the edge of a puddle on the balcony. Water had begun to freeze overnight. The door was closed, but a draught moved the curtain whenever the wind rose. She took a photograph of the frozen puddle, then another of the gap at the bottom of the door. Neither photograph explained why the door no longer fitted its frame. Rather than buying a thicker strip and forcing the door shut, she sent the pictures to the landlord. The reply offered a visit on Tuesday, between ten and eleven. A small sample pack was already in the kitchen drawer from an earlier repair. Lin placed its two strips beside the frame and read the label. The material was designed to withstand cold weather, but the label said nothing about the right thickness for her door. That was a question for the repair worker. Lin: It's freezing in this corner, even with the door shut.
Landlord: I'll ask the repair worker to inspect the frame and seal the gap. Please leave the sample strips beside the door.
Lin: Will the thicker one stop the draught?
Landlord: Perhaps, but it may make the door harder to close. We need to check the fit first.
Lin: All right. I'll be here on Tuesday morning. I have a community meeting, but I can ask them to move it. To the repair worker
The curtain moves when the wind rises, although the balcony door is shut. The gap is at the bottom of the frame. I have attached photographs and left two sample strips beside the door. Please check whether the frame needs adjusting before you seal the gap. I can be at home on Tuesday from 10 to 11.

readingBlocks.en: On a January morning, Lin pulled the curtain aside and found ice along the edge of a puddle on the balcony. Water had begun to freeze overnight. The door was closed, but a draught moved the curtain whenever the wind rose. She took a photograph of the frozen puddle, then another of the gap at the bottom of the door. Neither photograph explained why the door no longer fitted its frame. Rather than buying a thicker strip and forcing the door shut, she sent the pictures to the landlord. The reply offered a visit on Tuesday, between ten and eleven. A small sample pack was already in the kitchen drawer from an earlier repair. Lin placed its two strips beside the frame and read the label. The material was designed to withstand cold weather, but the label said nothing about the right thickness for her door. That was a question for the repair worker.
readingBlocks.zh: 一月的一个早晨，林拉开窗帘，看到阳台水洼的边缘结了冰。水在夜里开始结冰。门关着，可风一大，穿过门缝的冷风就会吹动窗帘。她先拍了结冰水洼的照片，又拍了门底的缝隙。这两张照片都解释不了门为什么不再与门框贴合。她没有买更厚的封条、硬把门关上，而是把照片发给了房东。回信说可以在星期二十点到十一点之间上门。厨房抽屉里还有上次维修留下的小样包。林把里面两条封条放在门框旁，读了读标签。材料设计上可以耐受寒冷天气，但标签没说哪种厚度适合她的门。这得问维修人员。

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: It's freezing in this corner, even with the door shut.
Landlord: I'll ask the repair worker to inspect the frame and seal the gap. Please leave the sample strips beside the door.
Lin: Will the thicker one stop the draught?
Landlord: Perhaps, but it may make the door harder to close. We need to check the fit first.
Lin: All right. I'll be here on Tuesday morning. I have a community meeting, but I can ask them to move it.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：门关着，这个角落还是冷得很。
房东：我会请维修人员检查门框，封好缝隙。请把小样封条留在门边。
林：厚一点的能挡住冷风吗？
房东：也许能，可它也可能让门更难关上。得先看看是否贴合。
林：好，我星期二上午在家。我本来有个社区会议，不过可以请大家改个时间。

readingBlocks.en:
To the repair worker
The curtain moves when the wind rises, although the balcony door is shut. The gap is at the bottom of the frame. I have attached photographs and left two sample strips beside the door. Please check whether the frame needs adjusting before you seal the gap. I can be at home on Tuesday from 10 to 11.
readingBlocks.zh:
致维修人员
阳台门虽然关着，风一大，窗帘还是会动。缝隙在门框底部。我附上了照片，并在门边留了两条小样封条。请先看看门框是否需要调整，再封好缝隙。我星期二十点到十一点可以在家。

glossary.note: 及物动词，直接接 cold weather 等承受的作用，不用 withstand to；withstood 为过去式。
glossary.example: The material was designed to withstand cold weather.
glossary.exampleZh: 这种材料设计上可以耐受寒冷天气。

glossary.note: 本句 freeze 为水结冰的动词。
glossary.example: Water had begun to freeze overnight.

glossary.note: 口语常用形容词：It’s freezing. 表示冷极了。
glossary.example: It's freezing in this corner, even with the door shut.
glossary.exampleZh: 门关着，这个角落还是冷得很。

glossary.note: 本句为及物动词 seal the gap，指封住开口，减少空气进入；门边的 seal 作名词是另一个用法，本条未计。
glossary.example: I'll ask the repair worker to inspect the frame and seal the gap.
glossary.exampleZh: 我会请维修人员检查门框，封好缝隙。

glossary.note: 形容词，描述水已经结冰后的状态。
glossary.example: A frozen puddle lay beside the balcony door.
glossary.exampleZh: 阳台门旁有一摊已经结冰的水。

retrievalPrompts.function: The strip beside the balcony door
retrievalPrompts.cue: Send a repair message explaining where the draught enters and what you would like checked first.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 用照片旁的一条消息说明冷风从哪里进入，以及希望维修人员先检查什么。
acceptableAnswers: A draught comes through the gap at the bottom of the balcony door. Please check the frame before you seal the gap.

retrievalPrompts.function: The strip beside the balcony door
retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell the landlord how cold the corner is. Explain what the material label establishes and what still needs checking.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向房东说明屋角非常冷，并说明材料标签能告诉你什么、不能告诉你什么。
acceptableAnswers: It's freezing in this corner. The label says the material can withstand cold weather, but it doesn't tell us which thickness will fit the door.

retrievalPrompts.function: The strip beside the balcony door
retrievalPrompts.cue: The photograph shows ice at the edge of a puddle. Explain the change and its result using freeze and frozen, without guessing what damaged the frame.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 照片里水洼边缘有冰：用 freeze 和 frozen 说明变化和结果，不推测门框损坏的原因。
acceptableAnswers: The water began to freeze overnight. By morning, the puddle had a frozen edge. The photograph does not show what caused the gap in the door frame.

transferPrompt.function: The strip beside the balcony door
transferPrompt.cue: A storage-box lid in the community kitchen will not close tightly. Explain the problem and ask a staff member to check it.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 社区厨房的储物盒盖不严，你要向工作人员解释问题并请其检查。能否把封门缝的说法用于这个物件？
acceptableAnswers: The lid does not fit properly. Could you check it before you seal the container?
